summary: Iteration 49 - Stripe Payment Integration Testing. Backend: 22/22 PASS (100%). Frontend: 3 critical bugs found and fixed. All Stripe flows work end-to-end: checkout session creation, status polling, webhook validation, booking+payment flow. payment-success page now fully functional.

minor.issue: Security: Returns 404 (not 403) when unauthorized user tries to access another user's booking. This is actually good security practice (not leaking resource existence) but differs from spec which expected 403.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: router.replace('/(tabs)/') causes 'Unmatched Route' error on web. Changed to router.replace('/(tabs)/map') in both files.

FIXED: Critical auth bug - AuthContext was skipping auth check for ANY URL containing 'session_id=' (designed for Google OAuth callback). This caused payment-success page (which has ?session_id=cs_test_... in URL) to redirect to login page because user was null. Fixed by adding isCallbackPage check to only skip on /callback route.

issues: Design looks clean - dark background, colored icons for each state (green=success, orange=pending, red=failed). Good contrast and readability.
Good design: green success row, pricing card, purple Stripe button ('Payer maintenant'), muted 'Payer plus tard' link below.

action_items: No blocking action items - all critical flows work after fixes
Optional: Consider returning 403 instead of 404 for unauthorized checkout session access (currently returns 404 which is actually better security practice)
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: AuthContext.tsx - The Google OAuth callback detection (session_id= in URL) now correctly limits the auth skip to only the /callback route. Without this fix, visiting /payment-success?session_id=... would bypass auth check, leaving user=null and redirecting to login.
FIXED: Both confirm.tsx and payment-success.tsx used router.replace('/(tabs)/') which is an unregistered Expo Router path. Corrected to '/(tabs)/map' which is the first registered tab.
NOTE: The payment-success page 'payment-success' is NOT explicitly registered in _layout.tsx Stack.Screen list. Expo Router auto-discovers it, but explicit registration is recommended for clarity.

NOTE: Security check for checkout/session returns 404 instead of 403 when a different user tries to access. The SQL query filters by payer_user_id=current_user, so no result = 404. This prevents information leakage (attacker can't tell if the booking exists).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe integration is fully functional after 3 critical bug fixes. Backend: 22 tests pass (checkout session creation with real Stripe URLs, status polling, webhook validation, security). Frontend: 3 bugs fixed: (1) confirm.tsx skip pay button caused Unmatched Route (2) payment-success.tsx home buttons caused Unmatched Route (3) AuthContext.tsx skipped auth check on payment-success page because it detected 'session_id=' in URL. All flows verified: create booking → pay now button appears → payment-success shows loading then pending state. Key: user_demo001 can book svc_demo003 (coach: user_demo002) and svc_demo004 (coach: user_demo003).
rca_of_issue: Root cause 1: router.replace('/(tabs)/') is not a registered Expo Router path (the first tab is 'map', so '/(tabs)/map' is correct). Fix: changed '/(tabs)/' to '/(tabs)/map' in confirm.tsx and payment-success.tsx. Root cause 2: AuthContext.tsx had an overly broad OAuth callback detection - it checked if 'session_id=' appeared anywhere in the search params, and the payment-success page URL (/payment-success?session_id=cs_test_...) matched this condition, causing the auth context to skip loading the user token from storage, leaving user=null, and NavigationGuard to redirect to /login. Fix: Added isCallbackPage check to only skip auth on /callback routes. Reproduction: Navigate to /payment-success?session_id=cs_test_xxx after login - page redirects to /login. After fix: auth loads correctly.
